+def test_session_refresh_vary(app, client):
+    @app.get("/login")
+    def login():
+        flask.session["user_id"] = 1
+        flask.session.permanent = True
+        return ""
+
+    @app.get("/ignored")
+    def ignored():
+        return ""
+
+    rv = client.get("/login")
+    assert rv.headers["Vary"] == "Cookie"
+    rv = client.get("/ignored")
+    assert rv.headers["Vary"] == "Cookie"
